visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person wearing a white t-shirt opens a large yellow circular cushion designed with colorful cartoon cat and dog illustrations. The background is a clean indoor setting with light-colored flooring. (2) Close-up shots feature hands holding a yellow metal cookie tin with similar cartoon designs and text reading 'TOGETHER WITH LOVE'. A blue gift bag with matching motifs is also showcased. (3) The scene shifts to a top-down view of the tin filled with star-shaped cookies in three colors: tan, brown, and green. A hand pulls a small paper fortune slip from between the cookies. (4) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white necklace and a black jacket over a white top, holds the paper slip and speaks to the camera with an expressive face. (5) Detailed close-ups show the cookies being broken in half, revealing a crumbly texture, and the woman eating them while making satisfied expressions. The background includes shelves stacked with yellow cans of 'Golden Churn' butter. (6) The exterior of the 'COOKIE886' shop is shown, featuring a white modern facade with large glass windows and black trim. The woman is seen dancing and posing excitedly in front of the store. (7) Inside the shop, customers are seen at a wooden service counter with 'Pick Up Area' signs above. The woman continues to display the product packaging and eats more cookies, including heart-shaped and leaf-shaped varieties from different boxes. (8) A cat-themed pet bed is shown with a real calico cat sniffing it, followed by the woman holding the lid of the pet bed while smiling.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo acoustic guitar BGM with a bright, energetic beat starts immediately. A female voice speaks with high arousal and a sharp, rising pitch, introducing the 'Mid-Autumn Gift Box'. (2) A subtle plastic rustling sound occurs as the gift bag is shown. The vocal delivery is rapid and enthusiastic, maintaining a friendly tone. (3) A distinct, crisp crunching sound (Food Bite SFX) is heard as a cookie is snapped in half. The BGM remains steady with a constant rhythmic percussion. (4) The speaker's pitch modulates higher as she asks a question about history, followed by a slight pause. (5) Short, stylized 'Whoosh' and 'Pop' sound effects are used to punctuate fast visual transitions between cookie flavors. The chewing sounds provide a recurring percussive texture. (6) Ambient room tone is minimal, masked by the dominant BGM and clear, studio-quality narration. (7) Vocal intensity reaches its peak during the announcement of a cat bed giveaway. (8) The BGM concludes with a final rhythmic strum as the narration ends, leaving a clean, silent finish.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Product Feature Showcase -> Tasting & Reactions -> Brand Credibility -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional endorsement for 'COOKIE886', specifically highlighting their limited edition Mid-Autumn Festival cookie boxes in collaboration with 'Dumpling Cat Family' (餃貓Family). It aims to drive sales and engagement through a product reveal, taste testing of different flavors (Original, Cocoa, and Alishan Black Tea), and a giveaway contest involving pet photos.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of product packaging, mentions of brand name 'COOKIE886', and a clear promotional giveaway call-to-action.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively combines cute character aesthetics with high-energy editing and appetizing food close-ups to target young consumers and pet owners.
